name: Birthday video
description: A personal birthday film: a name drawn in the night sky, photos gathering into a mosaic portrait, your message and a music finale.

photos.title: Choose the photos
photos.subtitle: The photos that gather into the mosaic, and the main picture (usually a portrait of the birthday person) they form.

steps.title: Names and message
steps.subtitle: Who the film is for, who it is from, and what you want to say.

fields.label: Birthday person's name
fields.help: Drawn in the night sky as a gold constellation and shown large after the mosaic forms.

fields.label: Your name
fields.help: Signs off the film: “Forever yours, <your name>”.

fields.label: Date line
fields.help: Small text under the name, for example 16  ·  NOVEMBER. Leave empty to skip it.

sections.title: Your message
sections.subtitle: Leave a blank line between paragraphs. One photo lifts out of the mosaic beside each paragraph. If the first paragraph ends with a comma (like “Priya,”) it is shown as a large greeting.

fields.label: Message
fields.default:
Dear friend,

You make every room warmer just by walking into it.

Thank you for being exactly who you are.

I hope this year is as kind to you as you are to everyone else.

steps.title: Wording
steps.subtitle: The small texts that appear during the film. The defaults work well; change them to make it yours.

fields.label: Opening lines
fields.help: Shown in the dark sky at the very start. One line per row.

steps.title: Photos and music
steps.subtitle: Optional featured photos and the song that plays under the film.

sections.title: Featured photos
sections.subtitle: Photos in this folder (named 01_..., 02_... in the order you want) become the framed pictures that lift out beside each paragraph. Without a folder, good photos are picked automatically from your tiles.

fields.label: Featured photos folder
fields.prompt: Choose the folder of featured photos

fields.label: Song
fields.help: Plays from the start and fades out at the end. Leave empty for a silent film.

steps.title: Look and pacing
steps.subtitle: Colours, reading speed and the film's overall grade.

fields.label: Reading time per word
fields.help: How long each message paragraph stays on screen. Lower is faster; the film gets shorter.

fields.label: Mosaic animation style
fields.help: How the photos gather into the portrait and how the camera moves while they do: Swarm = tiles swoop in while the camera sweeps; Vortex = the camera circles as tiles spiral in; Wave = a wave of tiles sweeps across; Zoom = starts macro-close and pulls straight back.
